# Code of conduct

Sinner's Workshop is a small, friendly fan project. This code applies wherever the project lives: this repository (issues, pull requests and comments) and the Discord server.

## Do

- Be kind and patient. Many people here are new to coding, to custom kits or to the game.
- Give feedback on ideas and code, not on people.
- Credit other people's work and ideas.
- Keep it welcoming for everyone, whatever their age, background, identity or ability.

## Don't

- Harass, bully, threaten or insult anyone. No hate speech.
- Post NSFW content.
- Share anyone's personal information, or ask for it.
- Post leaks, ripped game assets, or unreleased or datamined content.
- Spam, self-promote or sell things.

## Reporting

If something here makes you uncomfortable, tell a moderator on the [Discord](https://discord.gg/hZgMnDN5K), or use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment or issue. Reports are handled privately.

Moderators and maintainers may edit or remove content, and may warn, mute or ban anyone who breaks this code, on Discord and on GitHub.
